scripts.build: npm run -w @interviewly/types build && npm run -w @interviewly/ai build && npm run -w frontend build && npm run -w backend build
scripts.//test:integration: The vitest files `test` excludes: they need a live Postgres and Redis, which the CI `unit` job has neither of. Run against host-reachable servers — `.env`'s `db:5432`/`cache:6379` only resolve inside the compose network — by exporting DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL first (a shell export wins over --env-file).
scripts.test:integration: INTEGRATION=1 node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/vitest run --project worker --project node
scripts.//prepare: `|| true` is required for the production image builds: husky is a root dev dependency, so `npm ci --omit=dev` runs this script with husky already uninstalled and the install dies on `sh: husky: not found` (exit 127). HUSKY=0 does not help — npm still invokes the missing binary. There are no git hooks to install in a Docker build stage anyway.
